about: Things Claude needs from the learner (accesses, decisions, setup, materials). Shown at the top of assets/today.html and in /program's status. Claude adds items when it is blocked on the learner and removes them (done: true + done_on) once the learner confirms in a session. Ticking a box on the Today page only hides it in that browser; say it in a session so it's closed for real.

items.text: Rep 0: make Vim your editor: git config --global core.editor vim; export EDITOR=vim VISUAL=vim in your shell rc; Vim keybindings in your IDE (VSCodeVim / IdeaVim); run vimtutor once (~30 min).
items.why: Every eng lesson opens with a Vim drill and reps are edited in Vim.

items.text: Tell Claude 'push access OK' for the 3D chess repos when the first code rep starts (they're attached read-only now).
items.why: Claude writes the code for reps as PRs you review.

items.text: Pick a target date for the AWS MLA-C02 exam (book it, or give a target month).
items.why: Exam prep is deadline-driven; the AWS lane is paced backwards from it (lesson 0002).

items.text: Send the files from your 2024 AWS Solutions Architect Associate course (or say where they are).
items.why: AW101 uses its core modules (IAM, S3, VPC, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch) as the foundations.

items.text: Add your staff books (Reilly, Larson, Ousterhout, ...) to the book server, then say 'I added books' (/new-books).
items.why: Lessons can then quote exact passages and set exercises from them.

items.text: Yes/no on filing two proposed 3D chess tickets: Spark self-play analytics (RLAgent) and an engine hot-path profile (3dChessInC).
items.why: Claude never files issues without asking.

items.text: Edit the 'things I find interesting' list in topics/eng/PROGRAM.md §1b (or tell Claude): it drives the Friday interest block.
items.why: Some of this major is meant to be for fun.

items.text: Optional: want a monthly scheduled refresh of the cert/skill/pay catalog, even on days you don't study? (yes/no)
items.why: Otherwise it refreshes when a session sees it's due.

items.text: URGENT-ish: library/MANIFEST.csv (2,000+ book titles, 509 naming libgen/z-lib/Anna's Archive) is publicly served at rahulsanjay18.github.io/learning/library/MANIFEST.csv. Decide on the private-source split (notes/design-private-source-public-site.md); its step 1 (make this repo private) removes it from public view.
items.why: GitHub Pages on the free plan is always public; until decided, don't put anything private in this repo (inbox included).

items.text: On or after 2027-01-24 (day 90 at the new job): decide whether growing into staff there is the goal, and whether the day job becomes the staff lane's main venue.
items.why: You asked not to presume before knowing the job.

items.text: After installing Super Productivity: turn on WebDAV sync to a folder on your server, sync once, and send Claude a copy (or the file names + first lines) of what lands there. Also decide: work-task privacy (default: counts and time only) and encryption on/off.
items.why: So Claude can build the read-only /sp digest endpoint against your real file format (notes/super-productivity-reader.md).

items.text: Redeploy the progress server once more (copy the new progress-server/app.py, then docker compose up -d --build progress-server).
items.why: The Today page now counts a lesson as finished only when most of it is answered or rated. It needs the server to report how many questions per lesson are answered; until then, lessons finished on another device show as 'in progress' unless you rated them.
